definitions.explanation: A Korean side dish made from blanched or raw vegetables seasoned with sesame oil, garlic, soy sauce, and sesame seeds. Common in bibimbap and as a banchan (side dish). Well-known in Japan through Korean cuisine.

examples.japanese: ビビンバ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ナムル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧のせる。
examples.english: I put namul on top of bibimbap.

examples.japanese: ⟦もやし→もやし：10645_moyashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ナムル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。

ナムル⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ごま⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}れる→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{副菜|ふくさい}→副菜：04993_fukusai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぴったり→ぴったり：02362_pittari⟧だ。
examples.english: Namul can be easily made with sesame oil and salt, making it a perfect side dish.

notes:
USAGE:
ナムル is a Korean loanword (나물) that has become widely known in Japan through the popularity of Korean cuisine. It typically refers to vegetables (such as bean sprouts, spinach, or carrots) that are briefly cooked and seasoned with sesame oil, garlic, and salt.

COMMON VARIETIES:
- ⟦もやし→もやし：10645_moyashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ナムル (bean sprout namul — the most common)
- ⟦ほうれん{草|そう}→ほうれん草：05188_hourensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ナムル (spinach namul)
- にんじん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ナムル (carrot namul)
- {三色|さんしょく}ナムル (three-color namul — a combination)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ナムル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to make namul)
- ナムル⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{盛|も}り{合|あ}わせ→盛り合わせ：21762_moriawase⟧ (assorted namul platter)
